title: Klever Go counts bitmap padding bits toward BLS quorum, allowing blocks with insufficient signatures (CVE-2026-58262)
description: Klever Go versions prior to 1.7.20 contain a vulnerability in the block header signature verification process where padding bits in the public keys bitmap are incorrectly counted toward the BLS quorum. This flaw allows a malicious block producer to craft blocks that appear to have sufficient validator signatures by setting padding bits, even though fewer real validator signatures are present. This results in blocks being accepted without a genuine two-thirds validator quorum.
